<CLT=cltMIND>Keebo said that he saw something odd
while fighting in the courtyard.

<CLT=cltMIND>I should be able to see the
entire courtyard from here.
This must be what he was talking about...
<CLT=cltMIND>Alright, let's see if I can find something...

Himiko? How did you get out of
the hidden room?

The hidden door in the
library was destroyed...

We were so worried about you!
You were trapped in there...

Nyeh? You don't understand how I 
escaped from there?
Hmhmhm, I see...you don't get it...
You don't know how I escaped...

Then I shall tell you! I escaped from 
that sealed room with my magic!
...Himiko. Now is not the time for—
Eeeeeek!
Himiko! Are you okay?

Th-That was a close one!
I almost died!
I told you...now's not the time...
G-Got it. I'll tell you...

I definitely used my magic, but another thing
that helped me escape that sealed room...

...was the girls bathroom on the 1st floor
of the school building.
The bathroom?
Do you wanna go there with me?
Huh?

I-I'm not inviting you to go to the bathroom
with me! Don't start getting weird thoughts!
Ah, no, I know that...

<CLT=cltMIND>The girls bathroom on the 1st floor? What
does that have to do with the hidden room?

<CLT=cltMIND>There doesn't appear to be any new clues,
other than the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Flashback Light<CLT=cltMIND>.
Alright...I'll head to the bathroom.

The reason I was able to escape that room was
because of the bathroom on the 1st floor.
Come with me...to the bathroom...

But if you do anything stupid, I'll change 
you into a girl with my magic!
Ah...you don't have to worry about that.
<CLT=cltMIND>This is the room Keebo was talking about.
<CLT=cltMIND>I should investigate here.

<CLT=cltMIND>It might be for the best to just

<CLT=cltMIND>I should check...

I should ask her about it.
Yes

The sound I heard definitely came
from inside this locker.
I'll open it...
Ah, a Flashback Light!

<CLT=cltMIND>This is new...
It just got here.

Just as I suspected... You can make
Flashback Lights with that desk.

<CLT=cltMIND>I don't know why it was hidden
in a normal-looking classroom...

<CLT=cltMIND>but there must be a switch
hidden somewhere.

<CLT=cltMIND>Flipping that switch will cause this
desk to activate.

<CLT=cltMIND>I'm sure Keebo saw all this when
the room was destroyed...

<CLT=cltMIND>But what interests me is exactly how
these <CLT=cltSTRONG>Flashback Lights<CLT=cltMIND> are made.

<CLT=cltMIND>There's only one truth...
There should only be *one* true memory...

<CLT=cltMIND>But this clearly allows you to choose. Why?
And there's no indication of which are real.
Is there more than one truth...?
What is the truth...and what are the lies?

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"<CLT=cltSTRONG>Flashback Light Settings<CLT=cltSYSTEM>" has been added to the
Truth Bullets section of your Monopad.

<CLT=cltMIND>Right at that moment, the
classroom door suddenly burst open.
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>*woosh!*
There you are, Shuichi!
H-Himiko!?

<CLT=cltMIND>...Huh? The classroom changed
back to normal?

<CLT=cltMIND>So when the door opens...the classroom
<CLT=cltSTRONG>reverts back to normal<CLT=cltMIND>?

<CLT=cltMIND>I can assume that was done in order
to obfuscate the room's purpose.

<CLT=cltMIND>The person operating all of this
did *not* want us to see it.
<CLT=cltMIND>And if they're that cautious of us...

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"<CLT=cltSTRONG>Clues to the Mastermind<CLT=cltSYSTEM>" has been updated in
the Truth Bullets section of your Monopad.

I don't know what you're thinking, 
Shuichi, but...

Be happier that I survived! I was able to make
a spectacular escape from that sealed room!
Ah, right!

<CLT=cltMIND>How did Himiko escape when the entrance
was blocked by rubble?
Nyeeeh!? That's a <CLT=cltSTRONG>Flashback Light<CLT=cltNORMAL>!
Y-Yes, but we shouldn't use it...
Wh-Why!?

We might still be forgetting something 
important!

All these little things we keep remembering...
We might be able to get everything back at once!

To be honest, all these flashbacks 
are making me feel bad...

If we can get them all out of the way 
at the same time, I'd prefer that!
I know how you feel, Himiko...

<CLT=cltMIND>But I'm concerned about the settings
on these <CLT=cltSTRONG>Flashback Lights<CLT=cltMIND>.

<CLT=cltMIND>There should only be *one* truth, but
these settings allow you to choose. Why?
<CLT=cltMIND>And there's no indication of which are real.

Hm, I see. Looks like you're thinking 
of something, right?
I guess it's up to me to save your honor.

It's the least I could do for the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate 
Detective<CLT=cltNORMAL> for saving me so much.
Y-Yeah... Thank you.

<CLT=cltMIND>I should look through this...

<CLT=cltMIND>To test my deduction, I selected
one of the categories.

<CLT=cltMIND>This category is for <CLT=cltSTRONG>unlocking new memories<CLT=cltMIND>.
It looks different than the others...
<CLT=cltMIND>"Select the subject you wish to remember"...

<CLT=cltMIND>So there are still some memories
we haven't remembered yet?

If we can remember something new...
that would definitely be a clue.
...Alright, let's try it.

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what kind of memory it is.
I'll start with <CLT=cltSTRONG>"The Survivors."

<CLT=cltMIND>*All* of these should be <CLT=cltMIND>true events<CLT=cltMIND>.
So why...would you be able to select one?

<CLT=cltMIND>And these categories...there are several

<CLT=cltMIND>Do I...have to select the correct one?

I suppose I'll choose, "The survivors on
a different planet."
If that's true...there's more hope for us.

<CLT=cltMIND>I suppose I'm meant to

Alright... I'll press it.
